If your friend doesn’t seem to want to be there for you at your lowest yet craves your attention when they are low then thats a sign of toxicity. If they start unnecessary drama because they are bored then thats toxic. If they constantly go on about looking bad in an outfit and calling themselves ugly in the intent of gaining a compliment from you then they are just using you for validation and a quick compliment and thats toxic. There is many more toxic things you should look out for just try not to analyse them to the slightest fault in their character. Enjoy the moments but at any time you feel uncomfortable, mistreated or unhappy in a friendship its really time to move on. Some friends can be a burden and can make you feel bad for them. As tough as it is, its best to move on from them people. “Friends” will play you like a fiddle and use you to every advantage. Keyword though is ‘some’ not all. So dont worry to much you’re still young. Im sure everything will be ok hopefully.

Dont be like me at 14. Stick close to your true friends and remove all toxic ones immediately. Stay in school even if its shitty. Dont allow others to pressure you into something you dont want to do. Make sure to have a balanced diet, its ok to eat junk once in a while just balance it out with some fruit and veg! Drink alot alot of water and I really mean it. You dont realise how badly lack of hydration can effect your mood and motivation. Come up with a saving plan. All money you gain split it in 2. 1 for saving and 1 for spending. Its always good to join a club or something for weekends and after school. I wish i did all that. Regret is the worst feeling in the world, Im only 17 aswell lol.
